sources.title: Run Krea-2-Turbo GGUF Locally: Fast AI Image Gen Guide — AI Tutorial
sources.snippet: The GGUF format allows this model to run efficiently on CPU+GPU hybrid setups, making it accessible even for machines with limited VRAM. ... Use the `q4_k_m` variant for maximum speed on 8GB VRAM cards. Use `q5_k_m` or `q8_0` if you prioritize image quality and have 12GB+ VRAM. ... Krea-2-Turbo-GGUF is designed to run within the `llama.cpp` ecosystem, which provides the necessary inference engine for GGUF files.
